name: finish-schedule-simple
description: G4 — finish schedule depth. Captures the printable 'Report' window's HTML (report.ts's Finishes schedule section, built by the pure floorplan/finishSchedule.ts + shared finishScheduleHtml.ts renderer) via the window.open capture-sink intercept, and asserts the contractor-grade quantities: a keyed material code (FL-01), an area value (m²), the per-code totals table, and the verify-on-site caveat. Then repeats the same capture for the Drawing set's 'Finishes schedule' sheet (same pure builder + renderer) to prove the two documents never drift.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: patch-window-open
steps.eval: window.__capturedHtml = null; window.__origWindowOpen = window.open; window.open = function () { return { document: { write: function (html) { window.__capturedHtml = html }, close: function () {} }, close: function () {}, focus: function () {}, print: function () {} }; };

steps.name: click-report
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Report')); if (!btn) throw new Error('Report button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-report-captured
steps.failMessage: openDesignReport() never wrote HTML via the intercepted window.open

steps.name: assert-report-finish-schedule
steps.eval: (function(){ const html = window.__capturedHtml; if (!html.includes('Finishes schedule')) throw new Error('Report HTML has no Finishes schedule section'); if (!/FL-01/.test(html)) throw new Error('Report finish schedule has no FL-01 material code'); if (!/m²/.test(html)) throw new Error('Report finish schedule has no m² area value'); if (!html.includes('Totals by material code')) throw new Error('Report finish schedule has no totals-by-code table'); if (!/verify on site/i.test(html)) throw new Error('Report finish schedule is missing the verify-on-site caveat'); })()

steps.name: click-drawing-set
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Drawing set')); if (!btn) throw new Error('Drawing set button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-drawingset-captured
steps.failMessage: openDrawingSet() never wrote HTML via the intercepted window.open

steps.name: assert-drawingset-finish-schedule
steps.eval: (function(){ const html = window.__capturedHtml; if (!html.includes('Finishes schedule')) throw new Error('Drawing set HTML has no Finishes schedule sheet'); if (!/FL-01/.test(html)) throw new Error('Drawing set finish schedule has no FL-01 material code'); if (!/m²/.test(html)) throw new Error('Drawing set finish schedule has no m² area value'); if (!html.includes('Totals by material code')) throw new Error('Drawing set finish schedule has no totals-by-code table'); if (!/verify on site/i.test(html)) throw new Error('Drawing set finish schedule is missing the verify-on-site caveat'); window.open = window.__origWindowOpen; })()
